supporting_pages.title: View and filter error groups \_|\_ Error Reporting \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Filter error groups You can use the filters on the Error Reporting toolbar to filter by the status, the affected resources, and the region of the log buckets that store your log entries.

When you filter error groups by text, the bar graphs show grey bars to represent the number of error events that didn't match the text filter: For information on how Error Reporting organizes error events into error groups, see How error events are grouped .
